Desiege 0.2: GOG support, modern graphics options that keep the original look, mods, and a
reworked cursor. Still no game files are modified.

## What's new

- **GOG support.** The GOG release is detected automatically. Desiege routes around GOG's own
  renderer wrapper and lifts its hard-coded 60 fps cap (set `maxfps=` if you want a cap).
- **Graphics options**, all on by default and each one can be switched off in the launcher:
  - **Ambient occlusion**: soft contact shadows in creases, under objects and inside foliage.
  - **Per-pixel lights**: torches, spells and the light around your party light the scene
    smoothly per pixel, read from the engine's own light database, instead of the game's
    blotchy per-corner lighting.
  - **Sharpening** (contrast-adaptive, 3D world only) and **bloom** around fire and glowing
    spells.
  - **Anisotropic filtering 16×**, **full detail** on GPUs the game's 2002 tables call "slow"
    (today's AMD cards among them), **32-bit textures and depth** everywhere, and **soft
    character shadow edges** at 512 px.
  - **MSAA** 2×/4×/8× (off by default: expensive on integrated graphics, and it turns ambient
    occlusion and per-pixel lights off).
- **Insert** in-game switches ambient occlusion and per-pixel lights off and on, to compare
  with the original look.
- **Tabbed launcher** with a **mod library**: drag `.dsmod`, `.dsmap`, `.dll` or `.zip` files
  onto the window. **Code mods** (DLLs using the C API in `example-mods\desiege_mod.h`) need
  explicit trust before they're enabled; an FPS counter example is included.
- **Cursor**: no more black or white boxes flashing behind it, and no stretched cursor while
  moving. Its image and position now come straight from the game.

Ambient occlusion, per-pixel lights, sharpening, bloom, borderless and MSAA need the
[dxwrapper](https://github.com/elishacloud/dxwrapper) renderer fix, which the launcher
downloads on first start with your consent.

See the [README](https://github.com/aegis-dev/desiege#readme) for every option and how it works.

## Installing

1. You need **your own copy of Dungeon Siege 1** (Steam or GOG; both are detected
   automatically).
2. Download `desiege-v0.2.0-windows-x64.zip` below and extract it anywhere. Keep the files
   together.
3. Run `desiege-launcher.exe`, accept the dxwrapper download, pick your settings and press
   **PLAY**.

Upgrading from 0.1: your saved settings stay as they were; options that didn't exist in 0.1
start with the new defaults.

The executables aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time you run
the launcher ("More info" → "Run anyway"). You can verify the download against the `.sha256`
file, or build it yourself from source.

## Tested on

- Windows 11, Steam release, NVIDIA RTX 3070 Ti (0.1 features).
- Windows 11, Steam and GOG releases, AMD Radeon 680M (integrated) at 2880×1620, UI scale
  200 %: everything in this release.

## Known limitations

- The new graphics options are untested on NVIDIA and Intel GPUs; please report how it goes.
- Retail CD installs aren't auto-detected; enter the game folder manually.
- Legends of Aranna and multiplayer are untested.
- UI scale doesn't apply in windowed mode.

Bug reports are very welcome. Please attach `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Desiege\desiege.log`, your settings,
GPU and Windows version.

Desiege is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix, Microsoft or
Gas Powered Games. It contains no game files and requires a legally owned copy of the game.
